DAFTARKHWAN (Private) limited (THE “COMPANY”) 
   
 WRITTEN RESOLUTIONS OF THE Directors 
 OF THE COMPANY DATED _______________________ 202 2 
   
 
 Purpose of the RESOLUTIONS 
 IT WAS NOTED that the Company was seeking to receive funding by way of a convertible loan from Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited ( “ Online Classifieds Pakistan ”) in the principal amount in PKR equal to US$250,000 (the “ Loan ”). It was noted that if the Company fails to repay the Loan plus accrued interest by its maturity date, the Loan shall be converted into preferred ordinary shares in the Company (the “ Shares ”) and the Company shall issue such Shares to Online Classifieds Pakistan in accordance with the terms of a convertible loan facility agreement to be entered into between the Company and Online Classifieds Pakistan (the “ Facility Agreement ”). 
 IT WAS NOTED that t he purpose of the se resolutions was to approve : 
 entry into the Facility Agreement ; and 
 the issue of the Shares in accordance with the terms of the Facility Agreement , 
 (the “ Transaction ”) 
 IT WAS NOTED that t he directors declared that they had no interest in the matters of the resolutions and therefore were not debarred from passing the resolutions under applicable law or the Company’s constitutional documents. 
 Documents 
 IT WAS NOTED that following draft documents (the “ Documents ”) had been provided to the director s : 
 the Facility Agreement ; 
 a written resolution of the members of the Company authorising the directors to allot ordinary shares in the Company to Online Classifieds Pakistan in the event that the Loan is converted into shares in accordance with the terms of the Facility Agreement (the “ Written Resolution ”) . 
 Approval of documents 
 IT WAS RESOLVED that : 
 the Facility Agreement be approved ; and 
 the Written Resolution be approved and a copy of the same be circulated to the members of the Company. 
 Execution of documents 
 IT WAS RESOLVE D that any director of the Company be authorised in the name and on behalf of the Company to execute the Facility Agreement and execute (in the case of documents to be executed as a deed, with any other director or by himself in the presence of a witness) and deliver all such further documents and to take all such further action as he may consider necessary or appropriate in connection with the Transaction. 
 
 Signed by us being all of the directors 
 
 _____________________________ 
 Ahmad Habib
